description: This file is a shell script used to test HTTP proxy behavior, including setting up a test repository, cloning via proxy with authentication, and handling proxies like SOCKS. It contains setup routines, test cases, and related helper functions.

methods.name: start_socks
methods.description: Starts a SOCKS proxy server, creates a FIFO for output, runs the proxy script in background, and waits for it to be ready.

methods.name: old_libcurl_error
methods.description: Checks if the error message indicates that libcurl version 7.84 or later is required to support proxy paths.
